suggestion: cardId must be TC-<funcId> (e.g. TC-KERQ-352-01): append the upstream funcId verbatim after TC-; never rewrite the funcId itself.
summary is the developer's self-contained brief: distill it from the upstream funcDesc and process list — what to build, for whom, key behaviors; at least 40 characters.
summary must not contain placeholder markers (TBD/待定/占位): the card is what the developer picks up — settle unfinished content upstream, then re-issue the card.
Each task description must state what data moves between whom and the system (at least 8 characters): distill it from the upstream movement description; never just the data-group name.
Every acceptance point must be a verifiable, concrete statement (at least 6 characters): derive it from the upstream business rules and process behavior; state the observable result.
